chunks: Then he turned towards their gods and said: "Why do you not eat (of these offerings)?"
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Hud say to the idols of the people of Aad?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah As-Saffat, Prophet Hud (AS) confronts the people of 'Aad by pointing out the logical absurdity of their idol worship: if their gods were truly divine, they would consume the food offerings presented to them, yet they do not. This rhetorical question underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on 'Aql (reason) as a tool for verifying faith, demonstrating that idols are merely inanimate objects incapable of action or sustenance.
